description: Society and population statistics for the society bundle: the society.income provider's published income, poverty and inequality figures (World Bank PIP, Eurostat EU-SILC and the OECD Income Distribution Database) as each source released them, with welfare concept, equivalence scale, poverty line, PPP round and release vintage; never blended, re-harmonised, nowcast or filled. Every source is live-unverified until a dated run (docs/development/income-distribution-evidence/source-audit.md).

sources.update_cadence: PIP releases (typically twice a year; verify) and PPP-round changes
sources.scope: Bounded PIP API estimates at the 2.15 PPP$ line in 2017 PPPs, pinned to one PIP release: Germany (income, survey years), Indonesia (consumption, reference-year estimates as PIP labels them) and the Sub-Saharan Africa regional aggregate; headcount, poverty gap, Gini, median and top-decile share (operator must verify endpoint, parameters and field names)
sources.temporal_semantics: the pinned PIP release version dates the vintage; reporting_year is the reference year and survey_year the survey year

documents.label: PIP country estimates, Germany, survey years, 2.15 PPP$ (2017 PPP)

definition.income_definition: PIP welfare aggregate: household per-capita income or consumption as the underlying survey measures it, stated per value as welfare_type (verify against the PIP methodology handbook)
definition.source_text: Estimates at the stated international poverty line in PPP dollars per person per day of the stated PPP round
methodology_notes: Income and consumption estimates are not comparable and are never converted into each other (PIP methodology handbook)

references.locator: Poverty and Inequality Platform Methodology Handbook (verify)

sources.scope: Bounded EU-SILC datasets through the SDMX connector's ESTAT SDMX-CSV path: at-risk-of-poverty rates (Germany, Austria, Berlin NUTS 2), the Gini coefficient and the single-person at-risk-of-poverty threshold, OBS_FLAG letters verbatim (operator must verify dataset codes and key order)
